findings.text: the replayed gate's sbatch client wait is computed from the pre-profile bound, so a profile whose default time exceeds the replay bound has its wait killed early and the replay reports a false timeout, defeating the long GPU gate the profile exists for

a partition with no profile now carries --cpus-per-task and --mem on the srun step it did not carry before, so 'submits exactly as today' is not literal and the test only asserts the top-level sbatch argv

a measure whose partition is declared by the run but not by measure_partition builds a full checkout and then discards it before submitting partition arms, because _tests_only_checkout still reads only measure_partition

the memory validator accepts a value with an internal space such as '96 G' and the submission then emits it as one malformed --mem argument, so a malformed declaration is not refused at load as claimed
